rows.label: Insomniac Games
rows.hook: created the Ratchet & Clank series and the Spider-Man titles for PlayStation

rows.label: Nintendo
rows.description: Japanese multinational video game and consumer electronics company
rows.hook: created Mario, Zelda and Pokémon-publishing consoles like the Switch

rows.label: Remedy Entertainment
rows.hook: made Max Payne and Alan Wake, known for cinematic storytelling and bullet-time shootouts

rows.label: Valve Corporation
rows.description: American video game development and digital distribution company
rows.hook: makes Half-Life, Portal and Counter-Strike and runs the Steam storefront

rows.label: Capcom
rows.hook: created Street Fighter, Resident Evil and Mega Man

rows.label: Take-Two Interactive
rows.description: American publisher, developer and distributor of video games
rows.hook: publishes Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption

rows.label: FromSoftware
rows.hook: is behind punishingly hard Dark Souls and Elden Ring

rows.label: Sega
rows.description: Japanese video game developer and publisher and subsidiary of Sega Sammy Holdings
rows.hook: gave the world Sonic the Hedgehog and once made the Dreamcast console

rows.label: Naughty Dog
rows.hook: made Crash Bandicoot, Uncharted and The Last of Us

rows.label: Blizzard Entertainment
rows.description: American video game publisher and developer owned by Microsoft

rows.label: Electronic Arts
